mod_fire_desc: Electrical panel fire, proper extinguisher protocol, and A* AR emergency evacuation.
mod_gas_desc: Toxic gas detection, SCBA protocol, upwind positioning, and permit validation.
mod_machinery_desc: Lockout/Tagout protocol, dumper/conveyor danger zones, zero energy verification.
mod_ppe_desc: Hazard-appropriate personal protective equipment selection and compliance.
mod_emergency_desc: Hazard route avoidance, dynamic A* waypoints, safe assembly arrival.
instruction_scan_surface: Point camera towards floor and slowly pan until grid appears.
instruction_tap_to_place: Tap on detected floor surface to anchor industrial equipment.
instruction_identify_fire_hazard: Inspect the panel. Identify the fire source and fuel class.
instruction_choose_extinguisher: Select appropriate extinguisher. Danger: Never use water on live electrical equipment!
instruction_aim_base_pass: Target the base of the fire. Execute P.A.S.S. protocol (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep).
instruction_identify_exit: Identify primary and secondary emergency exits.
instruction_follow_ar_arrows: Follow dynamic AR escape arrows to the safe assembly point.
instruction_reach_safe_assembly: Proceed to assembly point for verification and roll call.
instruction_sound_alarm_initiate: Sound fire alarm immediately and alert emergency response team.
instruction_crouch_low_under_smoke: Drop low and crawl beneath toxic thermal smoke layers.
instruction_headcount_at_assembly: Report to safety warden at assembly station.
instruction_gas_scan_surface: Scan the ground and maintain a safe perimeter.
instruction_detect_gas_cloud: Gas sensor warning: Atmospheric hazard detected ahead.
instruction_stay_upwind: Position yourself immediately upwind of the plume.
instruction_select_respiratory_ppe: Select certified breathing apparatus for toxic atmospheres.
instruction_multi_gas_detector: Deploy 4-gas monitor (LEL, O2, CO, H2S) before entry.
instruction_entry_permit_decision: Evaluate atmospheric readings against permissible exposure limits.
instruction_confined_space_scan: Scan confined tank or underground manhole perimeter.
instruction_verify_entry_permit: Check entry permit validity, authorized sign-off, and isolation.
instruction_appoint_standby_observer: Ensure trained standby person is posted at entrance.
instruction_press_emergency_stop: Hit emergency stop button to halt all motion.
instruction_open_breaker_switch: Open primary circuit disconnect breaker switch.
instruction_affix_padlock: Attach safety hasp and personalized red safety padlock.
instruction_fill_danger_tag: Complete danger tag with name, date, department, and contact.
instruction_try_restart_zero_test: Press local start button to verify zero mechanical energy.
instruction_commence_safe_maintenance: Zero energy confirmed: Work may commence safely.
instruction_ppe_scan: Scan personal safety locker and PPE station.
instruction_select_mica_dust_ppe: Select particulate respirator and sealed eye protection.
instruction_emergency_scan: Scan mine corridor and escape airway.
instruction_navigate_safe_path: Follow highlighted escape airway avoiding rockfall hazard.
instruction_muster_station_arrival: Muster station reached. Log tag-in on tally board.
feedback_water_on_electrical_hazard: CRITICAL FATAL VIOLATION: Water conducts electricity! Severe shock risk.
feedback_co2_correct_choice: EXCELLENT: CO2 is non-conductive and safely displaces oxygen.
feedback_dust_mask_inadequate_for_gas: CRITICAL VIOLATION: Dust masks cannot filter toxic gases! SCBA required.
feedback_scba_correct_choice: CORRECT: Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus protects against toxic gas.
feedback_unsafe_entry_without_clearance: FATAL VIOLATION: Unsafe entry into IDLH atmosphere without clearance.
feedback_abort_alarm_correct: CORRECT: Entry aborted, alarm sounded, area cordoned off.
feedback_loto_applied_safely: SAFE: Lockout/Tagout applied in correct technical sequence.
feedback_work_without_loto_violation: CRITICAL VIOLATION: Working on energized equipment without LOTO.
q_fire_class_c: Which extinguishing agent is suitable for live electrical equipment fires?
opt_fire_co2_dry_powder: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) or Dry Chemical Powder
q_fire_pass_meaning: What does the safety acronym P.A.S.S. stand for?
q_gas_confined_entry: What is mandatory prior to entering a confined space in a mine?
opt_gas_test_oxygen_permit_standby: Atmospheric testing, entry permit, and designated standby attendant
opt_gas_light_match_test: Light a matchstick to test gas presence
q_mach_loto_purpose: What is the primary objective of Lockout / Tagout (LOTO)?
opt_mach_zero_energy_state_prevent_start: Ensure zero energy state to prevent unexpected machine startup
cert_not_earned: Certification Withheld: Safety Competency Standard Not Met
